req.title: Update task
req.statement: The system shall update mutable fields of the task and return the updated object when PUT /tasks/{task_id} is called with a valid body.

doc.reasoning: The test suite covers PUT /tasks/{task_id} across positive (valid full/partial updates), negative (missing task, invalid payloads), and boundary (max-length fields, min-length title, null description) cases. Each test uses in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite DB seeded from the spec. Assertions are exact-value to kill operator-flip, constant-bump, and boolean-negation mutants. The suite covers: EP (normal update path), BVA (title length 1 and 100 chars, description 500 chars), STC (completed false→true, true→false transitions), DT (partial vs full update), NEG (404 on missing id, 422 on empty title, 422 on oversized fields).

tests.name: test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_data
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists: title='Fix login bug', completed=false
actions: PUT /tasks/7 with {title: 'Fixed login bug', description: 'All done', completed: true}
expected: Response body has id=7, title='Fixed login bug', description='All done', completed=true

import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

def test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_data():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.db')
    os.close(fd)
    db_url = f'sqlite:///{path}'
    engine = create_engine(db_url, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    db = Session()
    db.add(models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    def override():
        s = Session()
        try: yield s
        finally: s.close()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.put('/tasks/7', json={'title': 'Fixed login bug', 'description': 'All done', 'completed': True})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 7
    assert body['title'] == 'Fixed login bug'
    assert body['description'] == 'All done'
    assert body['completed'] == True
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()
    os.unlink(path)

test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_data()
